title: A Parish for the Verdict Revisited
author: T. M. Hartwell
blurb: Silas Halloran, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
